verdict.rationale: The docs describe data retention controls (default 30-day retention, opt-in Zero Data Retention) and enterprise data features like Collections/knowledge bases, but there is no documented capability for a user to export their stored data (chats, collections, usage history) in open/portable formats. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability (data portability) means this is 'none' rather than 'na', since a hosted API/model platform storing user data could plausibly offer export.
